svg.title: Digital tick-to-trade budget of the KR260 10G path
svg.desc: 11 clocks of 6.2058 ns (plus 0 or 1 for the pause, plus up to 1 for the crossing phase on the board), 68.3 ns, from the GT word that completes the price to the GT word that completes the order start block; simulation, GT and optics not included.
svg.text: Digital tick-to-trade: 11 clocks = 68.3 ns (simulation; GT, optics and cable not included)
block spills into the next word (+1 on the pause clock)
One clock is 6.2058 ns (161.1328125 MHz). The same-clock bench shows the crossing's fixed part only; on the board it can be one clock longer or shorter.
TX: MAC register to the last bit of the start block on TXDATA = 2 clocks, 3 when the 1-in-33 gearbox pause falls on that clock. RX: word captured to MAC start strobe = 2 clocks.
Brief 58A at 1 Gb/s for comparison: 8 clocks of 8 ns = 64 ns, last price byte in to first preamble byte out (byte path, `results/b58a`).
